He was in heaven standing in line, waiting to be judged, when he took an unexpected request to transfer his soul into a person in another world. But there was a catch… "I want you to take revenge on someone for me within an hour. If you don’t, I’ll destroy your soul." With his skill trees as weapons, he would demonstrate his unrivalled strength in another world.
